gamification.title: Lives System
gamification.subtitle: How it works
gamification.description:
You have 7 lives (hearts). 3 consecutive errors in a quiz = -1 life. At 0 lives, you're locked out.

Recovery:
- Automatic: +1 life every 3h
- Reviews: 5 SRS reviews = +1 life
- Premium subscription: unlimited lives
gamification.highlight: Tip: Memorize well before starting a quiz!

encouragement.title: For beginners
encouragement.subtitle: It's normal to find this hard
encouragement.description:
Japanese is a complex language. If you find the first lessons difficult, that's NORMAL!

The first 3 lessons are more forgiving (5 errors instead of 3). Take your time, memorize well, and persevere.
encouragement.highlight: Mastery comes with practice. You will improve!
